packageSize.notes: Canary regression guard after moving heavy runtimes and the Superset CLI to on-demand resource packs. The active target is 100 MiB for user-facing release artifacts; 150 MiB is the temporary hard guard while the current 114.5 MiB macOS arm64 ZIP is driven below target.

build.notes: Canary GitHub Actions budget. Quick branch validation must feel cheap enough for frequent use; published quick canaries keep GitHub Releases as the installer channel and use S3-compatible storage only for on-demand resource packs.

startup.notes: Phase 0 regression guard for packaged-app startup marks. Replace perf-baseline.json with measured canary values after the first baseline capture.

runtime.notes: Dev/canary guard after the desktop-online-lite and resource-pack overhaul. Reports must separate current worktree app+helpers, visible Superset-related services, and whole developer-tooling pressure; optimization claims must not cite only the Electron subtree.
